title: Inconsistent framework labels and noisy third parties in scan results
description: Found on a design partner's Next.js app with CLI 0.0.26. Placeholder hosts (example.com, .test, .invalid) were reported as third parties, Notion was counted twice (notion.so and notion.com), underscore names such as Google_identity were not split, and Next.js appeared under several spellings. Jira: [DATAP-772](https://anthus.atlassian.net/browse/DATAP-772).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in scanner PR #108 (merge commit b11d6938, develop, 2026-10-22). Placeholder hosts are no longer third parties, Notion is one vendor, underscore display names are split, Next.js spellings map to one label. The scan summary part is fixed in the CLI. Shipped in @dataparade/cli 0.0.28 (0.0.29 is now latest); the 0.0.28 package contains isReservedPlaceholderHost, 0.0.26 does not.
